versions.changelog:
Initial release of shorts-designer.

- Generate customized shorts designs for print-on-demand and manufacturing-on-demand.
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, custom text and logos, interactive 3D viewers, and multi-view design generation.
- API enables creation of clothing design drafts from prompts, images, or structured options.
- Includes workflow for previewing, customizing, and sending shorts designs to manufacturers.
- Requires a OneKey Gateway access key for API usage.
